About
Here at your Gulf Shores, Alabama LongHorn Steakhouse we are passionate about serving you the very best steaks prepared and seasoned with our signature spice blend by our expert Grill Masters. For Steak Lovers,By Steak Lovers

IF YOU'RE HERE, YOU PROBABLY SPEAK OUR LANGUAGE: STEAK.

MAKING OUR FAMOUS, EXPERTLY CRAFTED STEAKS STARTS WITH PICKING QUALITY CUTS AND ENDS WHERE MOST GOOD THINGS DO: ON THE GRILL.

WHILE SOME TAKE SHORTCUTS AND CUT CORNERS, AT LONGHORN, WE DO THINGS THE RIGHT WAY BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT GREAT STEAK DESERVES. AND, MORE IMPORTANT, IT'S WHAT YOU DESERVE.

WE'D SAY MORE, BUT IT WOULD JUST MAKE US HUNGRY.

EVERY STEAK,
EVERY TIME

Fresh, never frozen steaks grilled by our experts, with just the right seasoning, and no shortcuts.

VIEW MENU
STEAK DONE RIGHT SINCE 1981

See what 40 years of steak expertise looks like.

Historical timeline carousel. Use previous and next buttons to navigate through milestones.
1981
WHERE IT ALL STARTED

LongHorn Steakhouse first fired it up in Atlanta, Georgia, on August 10, 1981.

1982
SNOW JAM

In 1982, a freak snowstorm hit Atlanta, shutting down interstate travel. Guests streamed into LongHorn for a night that got our legend started.

1996
 
A STEER IS BORN

Our iconic steerhead arrived. Soon, it would appear on more than 136 steakhouses in the East, Midwest, Southwest and Puerto Rico.

2007
KEEPING GOOD COMPANY

LongHorn Steakhouse became part of the Darden Restaurant family in 2007.

2009
 
THE NEW WEST

Our restaurant transformed from roadhouse to ranch.

TODAY
THE FLAME BURNS ON

With over 500 locations and counting, we’re still as fired up and hungry as ever.

YOU'RE ONE OF US

Are you ready to roll up your sleeves and show your passion for steak? We're searching for people who pride themselves on creating great food and great experiences.

NUTRITION

We are dedicated to always giving you, our fellow carnivores, the steak you deserve. We are committed to offering a menu with a broad range of fresh, flavorful options for the ultimate steakhouse experience.

FOOD PHILOSOPHY

At LongHorn, we believe in Steak Done Right. We start with fresh, never frozen, steak, but we don’t stop there. We only use the finest ingredients in our steakhouse, from fresh chicken and fish, to seasonal vegetables picked at the peak of ripeness. Doing things the right way isn’t always easy, but that’s never stopped us.

You can learn more about the food quality and safety pledge that LongHorn and the other brands in the Darden family have made by visiting the Darden website
- Learn about food quality and safety pledge
.

NUTRITION & ALLERGEN GUIDE

Every Guest deserves to know what's in their food, especially those with food allergies. We keep our food allergen information as up-to-date as possible, based on the information provided by our suppliers. However, because LongHorn menu items are made fresh to order, food may come into contact with allergens during preparation and cooking.

If you have a food allergy, PLEASE inform your server. You may wish to call our Guest Relations Department at 1-800-793-4126 before you visit if you have special concerns. We welcome your comments, but it can take several days to fully research a request.

Our Services use first-party Tracking Technologies as well as Tracking Technologies supported by our service providers and third parties, such as advertising partners. Here are more details on some of the main Tracking Technologies we use:

Cookies: Cookies are small text files that a website server stores on your computer or device. The length of time a cookie will stay on your device depends on whether it is a “session” or “persistent” cookie. Session cookies generally stay on your device until you stop browsing. Persistent cookies stay on your device until they expire or are deleted. We use both session cookies and persistent cookies on our websites. Many browsers allow you to adjust your settings to refuse cookies before accessing our website. Different browsers have different cookie-blocking features, so please review your browser’s Help Menu for instructions. You can find more information about how to change your browser cookie settings at allaboutcookies.org, and cookiepedia.co.uk.
Pixels/Beacons: Tracking pixels (also known as web beacons) are tiny graphics embedded invisibly on a webpage that may be used to deliver or communicate with cookies, to count users who have visited certain pages, and to understand usage patterns. Restaurant Information
What are the hours of operation for LongHorn Seakhouse®?
LongHorn Steakhouse locations are open seven days a week. We open for lunch at 11:00 a.m. and begin serving dinner at 3:00 p.m. Our normal closing time Sunday through Thursday is 10:00 p.m while on Friday and Saturday, we stay open until 11:00 p.m. Please note that closing hours may vary by region so check with your local LongHorn Steakhouse to be sure.
What are typical Holiday Hours at LongHorn Steakhouse?
We are closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day to allow our team members to spend time with their family and friends. On Christmas Eve we close at 8 p.m. We are open normal business hours on all other holidays.
How can I find a LongHorn Steakhouse location, or the phone number and address for a specific location?
For location information on LongHorn Restaurants, please use our Restaurant Locator. Enter the city and state or province, or the zip or postal code, to see a list of locations in the area. Addresses, phone numbers, and hours of operation will be provided.
If no locations are displayed, there are no restaurants within 50 miles of the city or zip code you entered.
Can I make a reservation?
LongHorn Steakhouse does not accept reservations but we offer Call-Ahead waiting which allows guests to call and add their name to the wait list. This reduces the wait time at the restaurant. Please use our Restaurant Locator to find the phone number of your local LongHorn Steakhouse.
Does LongHorn take large group reservations?
Though reservations are not accepted at LongHorn Steakhouse, there are some times more likely than others that we will be able to accommodate a party of your size. A phone call to a restaurant manager is the best way to determine how quickly your party may be seated. The best time to reach a manager is between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.
How can I suggest a city for a new LongHorn Steakhouse location?
Thank you for your interest in a LongHorn Steakhouse in your city! Our real estate team is always looking for new sites across the country. Visit our Contact Us page to share your suggestion.
Where can I find airport, Puerto Rico, International and San Antonio Locations?
For details regarding all of our Airport, Puerto Rico and International locations, click here.
Back to top
Restaurant Visit
Can I get a copy of my receipt?
For itemized receipts within 90 days, please contact the manager of the location you visited. Location information including phone numbers may be found here. Please enter the city and state (or zip code) and a list of locations with phone numbers will be displayed. The best time to reach a manager is between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.
For signed copies of credit/debit card receipts, you will need to contact the bank that issued the card to obtain a copy. Your bank card should have a toll-free customer service number on the back you may call for assistance.
I left something at the restaurant; can you tell me if anyone found it?
To see if your item was turned in, please contact the manager of the location you visited. Location information including phone numbers may be found here. Please enter the city and state (or zip code) and a list of locations with phone numbers will be displayed. The best time to reach a manager is between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.
Who do I call about an incorrect charge on my bill/credit card?
For the most immediate assistance regarding errors with your bill or charges, we recommend calling the restaurant and speaking with a manager. Location information including phone numbers may be found here. Please enter the city and state (or zip code) and a list of locations with phone numbers will be displayed. The best time to reach a manager is between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m.
Back to top
LongHorn Steakhouse Menu
Where can I view a copy of your menu?
Please click here to view the menu. Prices may vary slightly by location, so please select your nearest location.
I'd like to suggest an addition to your menu.
We consider your feedback extremely valuable to the success of LongHorn Steakhouse. Decisions about our menu are based on guest feedback and demand, along with an effort to keep our menu fresh and interesting. To share your suggestions for a new menu item, please see our Contact Us page.
Why was my favorite item taken off the menu?
Generally our promotional menu items are available for a limited time. We update our menus regularly based on demand and add new flavors to keep the menu fresh and exciting for our guests. Please click here to view the latest promotional menu items.
Back to top
Nutritional Information
Where can I find allergen or specific ingredient information?
For any allergen or other ingredient questions, please contact Guest Relations. We will be happy to research specific recipes for you to make sure you have the most accurate ingredient information possible.
What menu items contain gluten or wheat?
We've provided a downloadable and printable version of our gluten-wise menu for our U.S. restaurants here.
Where can I find nutritional information for menu items?
Visit our Nutrition Page for nutritional information. We've calculated nutritional information based on the entrée as it is described in our menu without changes or substitutions. We consider one entrée and all its contents to be one serving.
How did you calculate the nutritional data?
A laboratory that specializes in nutritional analysis evaluated each dish multiple times. The nutritional information will include all items detailed in the item description. For items offering your choice of a side dish, you would need to add in those counts as well. Due to the hand-crafted nature of our food and any guest substitutions or special requests, it's possible there could be minor fluctuations in the figures provided.
Back to top
Gift Cards
How can I purchase a LongHorn gift card?
It is easy to give the gift of an expertly grilled meal. Simply click here to order. All orders placed before 2 p.m. EST are fulfilled and shipped on the same business day.
I need help with a gift card order I placed on the website.
Our Gift Card Services team will be delighted to answer any questions you have about your gift card order placed.
You may speak with a gift card specialist by calling 
Phone
866-518-9106 for plastic cards sent via post mail or 
Phone
877-800-4819 for electronic cards sent via email.
How do I get the balance on my gift card?
You can check the balance on your card by clicking here or by calling the toll-free number listed on the back of your card and following instructions.
Are you buying a gift card to pay someone?
There are a variety of Gift Card scams that request payment by Gift Card. Darden Restaurants is not responsible for, and assumes no liability to you for, any unlawful conduct or fraud by any third party associated with any Gift Card. If anyone insists you pay with gift cards, decline the offer and report the incident to the FTC at ftc.gov/complaint.

Do your gift cards expire or have any maintenance fees?
Our gift cards do not expire or have any type of maintenance fees.
Can my LongHorn Steakhouse gift card be used at another Darden Restaurant?
Yes, your LongHorn Steakhouse gift card can be redeemed at any Darden restaurant - Olive Garden, Bahama Breeze, The Capital Grille, Yardhouse, Eddie V's or Seasons 52.
What can I do if I lost my gift card?
We are sorry to say, but we cannot replace lost or stolen gift cards.

Donations
How do I make a request for donation of food or a gift card?
Our company strives to help as many organizations as we can and is always looking for impactful ways to support the communities in which we operate. Our resources are limited, so donation requests are reserved for non-profit, charitable organizations that align with our core values.
Local restaurants manage donations so please contact them directly. The request should be made in writing and we ask that you please mail it on your organization's letterhead at least six weeks before your request is needed.
We also appreciate your understanding in advance that we are not able to support all of the requests that we receive.
To inquire about the status of your request, please follow up with the restaurant directly.

Local restaurants manage sponsorships for sport teams and events. Please contact them directly. The request should be made in writing and we ask that you please mail it on your organization's letterhead at least six weeks before your request is needed.

Where can I find LongHorn Steakhouse coupons?
Sign up for our LongHorn eClub and "Like" us on Facebook to receive exclusive offers.
Also check your mailbox periodically as well as your Sunday paper for LongHorn coupons.
How can I sign up for the LongHorn eClub?
Be the first to receive the latest news, exclusive rewards and LongHorn offers by signing up for our LongHorn eClub. You will receive an offer for a Free Appetizer with one adult entrée purchase just for signing up.
How do I stop receiving LongHorn eClub emails?
We're sorry you no longer want to be part of the LongHorn eClub. Please click here to unsubscribe. It may take up to 72 hours to process your request.

Employment
How can I apply for a job at LongHorn Steakhouse?
We're pleased you are considering employment with us. For existing LongHorn Steakhouse locations, please visit our Careers Page to apply online.
Locations that are not yet open will have a banner in place at the restaurant that indicates when the restaurant is "NOW HIRING." Applications for hourly employees are taken at the restaurant after that sign is posted.
How can I apply for a management position at LongHorn Steakhouse?
For current management opportunities, visit our Careers Page. After you submit your resume online, our Human Resources Representative will be in touch with you soon.

I have a suggestion for LongHorn Steakhouse, but it's not about the menu or a new location site.
Visit our Contact Us page to submit your suggestion or comment.
Does LongHorn Steakhouse offer franchise opportunities?
Click here to learn more about international restaurant franchising.
Where can I obtain an annual report?
You may download an annual report by visiting the Investor Relations section of our parent company's website, Darden Restaurants (www.darden.com).
What is LongHorn Steakhouse's stock ticker symbol?
The stock of LongHorn Steakhouse's parent company, Darden Restaurants, Inc., is traded on the NYSE under code DRI.

We're glad you like the LongHorn style! However, this is information we can't share. We have agreements with many of our vendors for exclusivity.
